properties.text: Here the base-image gets prepared to be added to the Dataset. Change settings or crop manually if necessary.

widgets_values:
# Consistent Character Creator 4.1 — BETA (Krea 2 Identity-Edit)

## Overview

Builds a **multi-view character dataset** from a single reference image: 24 named
scene passes (`T-POSE`, `CLOSE-FRONT`, `OFFICE`, `RUNNING`, `COFFEE`, ...), one
group per shot.

BETA is the lean variant: **no upscaling and no face-detailer stage.** Generate
at 1408x1408, then upscale or detail elsewhere if you need it.

Dataset tagging lives in a separate standalone tagging workflow.

### Colour legend

| Zone colour | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Grey** | Model loaders, settings, output naming |
| **Green** | Your inputs (reference image, style / clothes prompts) |
| **Purple** | The 24 scene passes |

---

## Required Custom Nodes

| Node Pack | Used for |
|---|---|
| **comfyui-krea2edit** | The edit engine: `Krea2EditModelPatch` + `Krea2EditGroundedEncode`. These are the nodes the v1.2 identity LoRA was trained for. |
| **ComfyUI-KJNodes** | Core routing (`GetNode` / `SetNode`), `JoinStringMulti`, `ImageResizeKJv2`, `StringConstantMultiline`. |
| **ComfyUI Impact Pack** | The Save-Dataset switch (`ImpactInversedSwitch`). |
| **WAS Node Suite** | `Image Save`, the dataset export. |
| **ComfyUI-AutoCropFaces** | Reference-face detection and crop. |
| **Mickmumpitz-Nodes** | `ImageCollect`, `ImageCollectUnpack`, canvas labels. |
| **ComfyUI-Krea2Synth** | **QC only** (identity score, dataset filter, contact sheet). Not in the generation path; remove the DATASET QC group if you do not want the dependency. |
| **ComfyUI-Easy-Use** | `easy showAnything` in the QC group. |

---

## Required Models

| Model file | Loader | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors** | UNET Loader | Krea 2 Turbo. 10 steps, CFG 1.0. |
| **qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors** (with vision weights) | CLIP Loader, type `krea2` | Text and reference-image encoder. Vision weights are required or references cannot be encoded. |
| **wan_2.1_vae.safetensors** | VAE Loader | VAE for the image chain. |
| **krea2_identity_edit_v1_2.safetensors** | LoRA Loader | Identity-Edit LoRA, strength 1.0, in `models/loras/krea/`. |

The QC nodes download AuraFace and a MediaPipe landmarker into
`models/krea2synth/` on first use. Both Apache-2.0.

---

## Settings, and why they are what they are

The generation path is stock ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit. A fork with extra dials
(fit reference geometry, an attention boost on the reference keys, reference
CFG, a raised Qwen3-VL grounding budget) was built and benchmarked against this
baseline over six rounds. **None of it survived multi-seed testing**: across six
seeds on both a wide and a close-up scene, every variant scored worse than
stock. The apparent advantage in the earlier 24-cell sheets came from those
sheets running a single fixed seed per cell.

So: no reference boost, no reference CFG, upstream 384 px grounding and 1 MP
reference latents.

**Resolution: stay at 1408x1408 (2 MP).** Measured from 1 to 4 MP, identity is
flat and the first duplicated subject appeared at 4.19 MP. Note that in a
full-body shot at 2 MP the face is too small for the QC landmarker to measure.

**OFFICE** runs on the patched model. It used to be wired to the bare UNET,
which silently discarded its reference latents and duplicated the subject in 4
of 4 test samples; on the patched model, 0 of 4.

nodes.title: READ ME - manual face override
widgets_values:
## Manual face override

`AutoCropFaces` does **not** fail loudly when it finds no face - it returns the input image unchanged, so `INPUT_FACE` silently becomes the whole picture and the face reference is lost.

Check **Preview Image (Face Reference)** in INPUTS. If it shows the full image instead of a head crop, no face was found.

Then: upload a hand-cropped face into **MANUAL FACE CROP** and switch **USE MANUAL FACE** to true. It overrides both `INPUT_FACE` and `REF_Image`. Any size works, the existing resize nodes handle it.

Needed for stylised subjects: the detector is trained on real faces and finds nothing in anime or some 3D renders, at any upscale.

nodes.title: MANUAL FACE CROP  (used when USE MANUAL FACE is on)
KREA2-EDIT INFO (BETA)
widgets_values:
# 🟩 BETA notes — v1.2 nodes

Runs **comfyui-krea2edit** (lbouaraba), the node pack the v1.2 identity LoRA was
trained for. Measured against the ostris path on the same LoRA, same seeds:
**+0.49 identity on close-ups, +0.31 to +0.39 on medium shots.**

⚠️ The CLIP must be the **bf16** Qwen3-VL build. The fp8 one has no vision
weights and reference images silently stop working.

**Turbo only.** Steps and CFG fixed at 10 / 1.0. **No upscaler or face detailer** —
generate at 2 MP and refine elsewhere.

**`ref_boost`** is a global dial (default 4.0). It applies to the LAST reference,
which is the face crop. **`grounding_px`** (768) is the Qwen3-VL budget.

These nodes take **two** references. PARK-SMOKE and SKY-LOOKUP wire three in the
original graph, so their third is not used.
